name: Borgentreich (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over yellow, charged at the centre with the city arms of Borgentreich (a cross and a fleur-de-lis above a blue wall).
history: By deed of the Regierungspräsident in Detmold of 19 July 1976 the city was granted the right to bear arms and a flag, described as red and yellow striped with the city shield.

features.role: Borgentreich arms — cross, fleur-de-lis and wall
